CoreLink connects simulators, sensors, training workflows, and performance data into one integrated environment. Designed as the foundation for Human-Aware training, it enables richer operator-performance data and supports increasingly intelligent, adaptive training experiences. One Layer Across Training Systems CoreLink provides a common integration layer for simulators, XR systems, sensors, and training applications. Its modular architecture is designed to support different simulation environments without being tied to a single platform. From Simulation Data to Human Performance Insight CoreLink brings together simulator telemetry and human-performance signals to create a deeper view of operator performance. This connected data layer can support performance analysis, root-cause identification, and more adaptive training over time. A Foundation for Simulator-Agnostic Training Intelligence CoreLink is being developed as the backbone for Eyeviation's broader Human-Aware training ecosystem. The long-term direction is to enable existing simulators to connect to a common intelligence layer that helps interpret human performance and support more individualized training. TALK TO EYEVIATION Learn how CoreLink can connect your training ecosystem. Whether you are integrating simulators, sensors, or building next-generation training workflows, CoreLink is designed to be the common intelligence layer behind it.
